zh: 大幅優化 Android 更新包下載體積：直接 APK 渠道改用壓縮 JNI 原生庫。以本地同一套 Debug 包實測，APK 由約 197.9 MB 降到約 107.5 MB；正式 Release 仍會由 CI 重新量測與校驗，不以 Debug 數字冒充正式包大小。
OTA 更新新增 ABI 小包機制：正式發布時同時產生通用 APK、arm64-v8a、armeabi-v7a 與 x86_64 專用 APK。升級到本版本後，後續 Android 更新會優先按裝置 ABI 下載對應小包，無法識別 ABI 時才安全回退通用 APK；舊版清單格式仍完全相容。
更新清單升級到 schema 2，可記錄每個 APK 的 URL、SHA-256 與檔案大小；發布流程會同步把四種 APK 上傳到公開更新倉，保留原本通用 APK 作為兼容後備。
智能計算器補強真實口語與錯字理解。「10萬本金10年翻10倍的年化日是多少？」現在可直接理解為本金 10 萬、10 年後變成原本金的 10 倍，零追問反推等效複合年化約 25.89%。同時支援 `10w`、`10年x10`、`10x`、`翻十倍`、`年化幾多/年化？` 等常見輸入。
擴大「正常人打字」對抗測試：補上省略標點、口語粵語、k/w 縮寫、簡短 IRR 問法、`每月再投`、`最後幾多`、`保單表`、`比下` 等寫法，避免智能計算器只對標準範例句有效。
「可以這樣說」不再一次鋪滿十幾個例子，改成「常用、年化/回報、存錢/目標、產品分析/比較、組合/退休」五類切換；每次只展示當前類別 4–5 個例子，手機首頁更易掃讀。
完整 Flutter 回歸 109 項全部通過；新增 Android ABI 選包單元測試、390×844 錯字輸入流程與分類示例 UI 測試，相關 Dart 靜態分析 0 issues，Android Debug 構建及 JNI 壓縮包驗證成功。
en: Significantly reduced Android direct-APK download size by switching native JNI libraries to compressed APK packaging. On the same local Debug build, APK size dropped from about 197.9 MB to about 107.5 MB. Release size is measured again in CI rather than presenting Debug numbers as production figures.

Added ABI-aware OTA packages. Releases now publish a universal APK plus arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64 standalone APKs. After installing this version, future Android updates prefer the device-specific APK and safely fall back to the universal package when ABI detection is unavailable; older manifests remain compatible.
Upgraded update metadata to schema 2 with URL, SHA-256 and file size for every Android artifact, while retaining the universal APK as the backward-compatible fallback.

Hardened Smart Calculator handling of real typing and typos. `100k principal, 10 years, 10x — what annualized return?` and the Chinese typo form `10萬本金10年翻10倍的年化日是多少？` now resolve directly to an equivalent compounded annual return of about 25.89%, with support for `10w`, `10年x10`, `10x`, Chinese multiple wording and short annual-return questions.

Expanded noisy-input regression coverage for omitted punctuation, Cantonese phrasing, k/w abbreviations, short IRR questions, monthly-additional-investment wording, shorthand policy-table wording and casual comparison phrases.

Reorganized the Smart Calculator example area into five filters — Common, Return/IRR, Goals, Products, and Portfolio — so the mobile home screen shows only 4–5 relevant examples at a time instead of a long unstructured chip list.

All 109 Flutter tests pass. Added ABI artifact-selection tests, a 390×844 typo-input flow and categorized-example UI regression; targeted Dart analysis reports 0 issues, and the Android Debug build with compressed JNI packaging succeeds.
